verdict.rationale: OCI ships official Getting Started tutorials such as "Launch an instance" and "Get started with the CLI" (oracle-cloud-docs-13). The CLI install docs show exact copy-paste commands (oracle-cloud-docs-27), and Cloud Shell provides a CLI pre-configured with credentials (oracle-cloud-docs-2). The Free Trial and Always Free offers let a developer start from zero (oracle-cloud-docs-10, oracle-cloud-docs-11). However, nothing shows a quickstart that deploys a running application service with exact commands end-to-end, or that a first deploy takes under an hour; one user's report that OCI ran "working flawlessly with ssh, out of the box" is only anecdotal. Missing for 10: end-to-end quickstart deploying a running service with exact commands, evidence of time-to-first-deploy under an hour, independent hands-on onboarding corroboration.
